boundary_decision.status: accepted as a jurisdiction-qualified employment relationship
boundary_decision.rationale: The model represents one work relationship between a worker party and an employing party. Membership, parties, positions, assignments, occupations, contracts, payroll, attendance, benefits, tax, social insurance, qualifications, recruitment and evidence remain distinct linked records or objects.

decisions.rationale: The current registry explicitly requires Employment to exclude generic belonging and affiliation, which are owned by WM-ORG-006 Membership.

A worker-employer pair may have several concurrent or successive relationships, so neither party pair, job title, assignment, contract number, payroll account, start date nor hash is sufficient identity.

decisions.disposition: accepted as purpose-qualified and jurisdiction-qualified assertions
decisions.rationale: Statistical, tax, social-insurance and labour-law status may differ, while ILO Recommendation No. 198 makes facts and national determination mechanisms more important than party labels.
ICSE-18 organizes jobs by authority and economic risk and helps recognize employees and dependent contractors, but it does not itself create universal legal status.
Employer, agency, host, client, paymaster, platform and competent authority may differ, especially for temporary-agency, dispatched and platform-mediated work.
WM-ORG-016 owns assignment identity, scope, execution and lifecycle. Employment owns only the typed interval-qualified link showing that an assignment realizes the relationship.
ISCO-08 distinguishes a concrete job from an occupation class, and W3C ORG distinguishes posts and roles from qualified person-organization relationships.

Contracts, collective agreements, policies, payroll, attendance, benefits, tax and social-insurance records keep their own masters and lifecycles; Employment records applicability, precedence and evidential links.
A competent determination may be retroactive, but it must not erase what parties or systems previously asserted or when the determination became known.

decisions.disposition: accepted as multi-party provenance, not unilateral ownership
decisions.rationale: Both parties may contribute and hold evidence, but neither party automatically controls the other's lawful access, correction, portability, dispute record or retention duties.
Assignments, payroll events, workplace access and old contracts may be evidence but never alone establish current employment, suspension, continuity or separation.
The relation ledger contains a candidate WM-ORG-005 COMPOSE WM-ORG-016 row, not an approved relation, so the proposed assignment-realization link remains draft.
